description: Check a property number: returns the normalised value, a refusal code when it certainly is not a property number, and warnings that do not block. County and locality are optional: without them only the format is checked; with them the check adds the local number-range warning and the order mode, price and term. Use it before create_order_link when unsure; it stores nothing and prepares no link.

cadastralNumber.description: Optional second number, usually the cadastral number, when the person has both.

county.description: The county: its numeric id as text (from list_counties) or its name, with or without diacritics.

documentType.description: Catalogue id of the document. EXTRACT_CF (default) is the land-registry extract for information.

estateIdentifier.description: The property number as the person has it: CF number, cadastral number, topographic number or electronic identifier, for example 40461 or 8014-C1-U5.

locality.description: The locality: its numeric id as text (from search_localities) or its name, with or without diacritics.

name: check_property_number
title: Check a property number
